review.notes: Full review of the revision adding §§3.3-3.5 (finiteness criterion, commuting-partition splitting, finite Coxeter classification). Gate rerun: FAIL only on readme-ids-missing=7 (R02, unqualified TauCeti.DynkinType.coxeterMatrix_* names); depcheck 205 roadmaps, 1896 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean exit 0 with 15 sorry warnings only; #check @name signatures of the 8 new declarations match the README; one-tactic probe (simp, rfl, decide, infer_instance, exact?, aesop) closes none of the 5 new theorems. Seeded sample: all 15 targets; 25 locators checked against text (davis08 fetched from the author's page, 9 incl. Table 6.1 rendered; milne17 9; sga3iii 7); humphreys90/bourbaki46/bjornerbrenti05/humphreys72/kac90 uncertified, by locator. Adversarial table of 30 rows; every Davis Table C.1 determinant, the H3/H4 minors and the seven comparison vectors recomputed numerically; 20 decide/simp checks of FiniteCoxeterType entries and native vs Mathlib D4 at the pin. Blocking: R01 Summary states the finiteness criterion without finite generation (refuted by the roadmap's own I=N Check). P3: gate names, undeclared ofDynkinType, two missing locators, a Conventions sentence contradicted by §§1.3-1.4, the description's summary sentence, and no manifest record for davis08. Ownership: RootSystems on main owns the Coxeter classification (ReflectionInvariantTheory, KacMoody); no open PR changes RootSystems.
